verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes mail, contacts, and calendar data through JMAP, an open standard that replaces IMAP, CardDAV, and CalDAV. It supports token-based API access and publishes an open-source and standards commitment, so a user could pull their data out programmatically over open protocols. However, the pack documents no dedicated export feature, and the migration docs cover importing into Fastmail rather than leaving it. missing for 10: a documented full-account export tool, explicit open export formats (mbox/EML, vCard, ICS), coverage of non-mail data such as filters and settings, and independent hands-on reports of exporting and leaving.
